leadText:
----
 
(Japanese: ゴン爺 Old Man Gon) is a character of the day who appeared in Houndoom's Special Delivery. He was not given a name in the English dub.

While he was tending his , Old Man Gon noticed his , Doomy, had found a . He found out that the Togepi belonged to and was happy that she showed up and got it back. However, came by and tried to steal Doomy by firing a net at it. and then d Team Rocket and freed Doomy. After Team Rocket's defeat, Old Man Gon and Doomy led the group back on their way, saying their goodbyes.
